Defensive Fighting

Version

Unknown.

Status

Deprecated.

Defensive fighting was a Combat Mode that directed characters to focus primarily on blocking attacks. This mode would cause characters to take less damage, but they would also deal less damage when attacking a creature or another player. It was removed from the game on Vocation Adjustments 2026 update.

Defensive mode was used the most in the following situations:

  • As a Knight, when blocking for another player.
  • If a Knight or Paladin were training.
  • Sorcerers and Druids would use this mode all the time, as it did not affect the damage dealt by the wands or rods.
